en: Winter-themed Romanian greeting postcard. The front shows red-white script reading "La multi ani!" above a lit candle on a decorative holder set over fir branches and snowflakes, with an inset photo of a child in traditional Romanian winter dress holding a bouquet of colorful flowers. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp, postmarks, and an address to Bucharest.
